title: Anthropic 论文称 VP 严格小于 VNP 形式化代码已公开
content: Anthropic released a 70-page paper demonstrating that VP is strictly smaller than VNP across all fields. The proof, discovered and drafted by an internal Claude model, is formalized in 73,000 lines of Lean 4 code, with only one determinant complexity corollary remaining unformalized. This work addresses the Valiant conjecture using Hamiltonian cycle polynomials and auxiliary polynomial constructions. The paper includes nanoda checker verification, though independent review by human mathematicians is still pending.

content: Jensen Huang returned as NVIDIA’s CEO after an eleven-day resignation, prompting a 31% surge in the company’s stock and broad market rebounds. The board, under pressure from the Trump administration, reinstated him within hours, notifying senior executives only at the last minute. Although Huang thanked employees for a second chance, an internal investigation continues, and new compliance measures have been implemented to address national security concerns. This rapid reversal highlights the founder’s critical role in stabilizing investor confidence and advancing NVIDIA’s AI chip development roadmap.

EFS allows customers to store encrypted model data in their own S3 buckets using custom KMS keys, while EDC uses Amazon-managed storage. Both offerings provide automated safety monitoring, create review cases for human analysis, and ensure prompts are not used for model training.

title: 国产大模型的黄仁勋变量
content: Recent US export restrictions on advanced chips have severely limited domestic Chinese AI firms' access to high-end NVIDIA hardware, complicating next-generation model training. As high-performance computing costs surge and supply remains uncertain, industry experts debate strategic shifts toward domestic GPUs and cost-efficient smaller models. Simultaneously, tightened anti-distillation measures by US companies have increased data acquisition difficulties. With limited computational resources and rising expenses, the AI sector faces intense price competition, prompting investors and researchers to reconsider sustainable business models and prioritize infrastructure optimization over unattainable scale.

title: 刚刚，Claude 黎曼猜想证明的主导者回应一切
content: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge clarified that the widely reported 250,000-page claim regarding his Claude-assisted formal proof of the Riemann Hypothesis was a joke. While the proof involves 17.3 million lines of Lean code, Alpöge acknowledged the code’s current redundancy. He emphasized that his priority is using the work to develop a more natural mathematical framework, noting that AI’s speed in generating proofs now challenges mathematicians to efficiently assimilate and simplify these complex outputs.

title: 被列入美国实体清单后，中国企业开始“疯狂读论文” | 原文
content: A recent study in Science reports that Chinese companies restricted by the U.S. Entity List have significantly increased their citation of scientific patents. The estimated annual increment in these citations equals 72.3% of the pre-restriction average. Companies previously heavily reliant on American technology showed the most pronounced shift toward this behavior. This trend indicates that, unable to acquire advanced equipment or licenses, these firms are turning to independent research and literature review to develop necessary technologies from scratch.
